format.name: Rule world: the mask that holds you in memory

title_working: In This Town, Taking Off Your Mask Erases You From Everyone's Memory
world_rule: Everyone wears a smile mask. Taking it off erases you from everyone's memory.
logline: Only the narrator remembers his vanished friend, until a nameless new girl scratches her mask the same way, and his own mask starts to itch.

characters.name: the new girl (Pia)
characters.role: Rex, back with a new face

lines.text: In this town, taking off your mask erases you from everyone's memory.
lines.say: (confident) In this town, taking off your mask erases you from everyone's memory.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone wears a white smile mask, all day and all night.
lines.say: (happy) Everyone wears a white smile mask, all day and all night.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My best friend Rex hated his. He scratched at it when he was nervous.
lines.say: (sad) My best friend Rex hated his. He scratched at it when he was nervous.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One lunch, he checked that nobody was looking.
lines.say: (nervous) One lunch, he checked that nobody was looking.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then he slowly pulled his mask off.
lines.say: (nervous) Then he slowly pulled his mask off.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The cafeteria froze. A teacher screamed, Rex, don't!
lines.say: (surprised) The cafeteria froze. A teacher screamed, Rex, don't!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He vanished before his mask even hit the floor.
lines.say: (surprised) He vanished before his mask even hit the floor.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: By dinner, nobody remembered him. Not his teachers. Not even his parents.
lines.say: (sad) By dinner, nobody remembered him. Not his teachers. Not even his parents.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Nobody, except me.
lines.say: (sad) Nobody, except me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A week later, a new girl joined our class.
lines.say: (happy) A week later, a new girl joined our class.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She wouldn't tell anyone her name.
lines.say: (nervous) She wouldn't tell anyone her name.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But she kept scratching her mask, exactly the way Rex used to.
lines.say: (surprised) But she kept scratching her mask, exactly the way Rex used to.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: After school, she grabbed my arm. Have you ever seen your parents without their masks?
lines.say: (nervous) After school, she grabbed my arm. Have you ever seen your parents without their masks?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I tried to remember. I couldn't.
lines.say: (sad) I tried to remember. I couldn't.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That night, I shined a flashlight into my parents' bedroom.
lines.say: (nervous) That night, I shined a flashlight into my parents' bedroom.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Their masks had no straps. No seams. And they were breathing.
lines.say: (nervous) Their masks had no straps. No seams. And they were breathing.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: At dawn, I found her at the old playground. I whispered, Rex?
lines.say: (nervous) At dawn, I found her at the old playground. I whispered, Rex?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She froze. Then she nodded.
lines.say: (soft tone) She froze. Then she nodded.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The masks bring you back, she said, but with a new face nobody will ever look at.
lines.say: (sad) The masks bring you back, she said, but with a new face nobody will ever look at.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I smiled. I had my friend back.
lines.say: (happy) I smiled. I had my friend back.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then my own mask started to itch.
lines.say: (surprised) Then my own mask started to itch.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And I couldn't stop scratching it.
lines.say: (nervous) And I couldn't stop scratching it.
lines.speaker: narrator
